leadText: My Besties♡COMIC (Japanese: ) is a Pokémon 4Koma by momo irone created to promote ＃POKÉGENIC in Shibuya ～My Besties♡～. It was published from October 4 to November 8, 2024 on the official Japanese Pokémon Instagram account and from October 4 to November 15, 2024 on Poké Times. It consists of 12 comic strips divided into four mini-arcs.
